semantic_fidelity.reason: All 17 component IDs and all 23 unique directed endpoint pairs occur in the four specs (24 instances because mch->agent repeats). Only 17/23 relations preserve both readable identity and full required label meaning: repair, reprovision, S3 boot arguments, machine state and verify-reimage meaning are lost, and private-gRPC machine-rows association is uncertain. No reversed or unexpected endpoint pair was found. Historical claims remain qualified, not independently verified architecture facts.

arrow_traceability.reason: 22/23 unique endpoint directions can be traced; the remaining pgrpc->db route is interrupted by machine rows and the row-31 crossover. Separate ports and no-shared-corridor checks do not resolve blind uncertainty. No false connected branch or extra endpoint pair is asserted.

layout_fit.reason: All four actual panes are 77x47; launch/script records establish natural 100% with no pan/zoom/fit keys. All 27 displayed boxes fit, but full-label and complete rendered-coverage gates fail because v2 boot response and v3 machine state labels are omitted. Controls do not occlude the graph. Cropped application help alone is not scored as a graph-fit defect.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Layout respects local chain order, but per-depth hues create unsupported mixed conceptual groups and inconsistent identities across views. Shared host/agent and gRPC concepts do not retain related hues while unrelated same-depth nodes are presented as one family. Source-defined concepts are not replaced by geometric rank merely because the renderer colors rank.

border_integrity.reason: Raw ANSI proves complete four-sided rounded borders on all 27 displayed boxes, each border uniformly colored. In all four captured selected states, all sides/corners change together to bold gold; no muted-edge-colored handle, missing corner, border dot or label occlusion of a border was found. Plain text was not used as color proof.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen skill/binary/rubric/dataset/case/spec/capture/frame hashes verify; actual reviewer identity is Astra and frozen generator evidence names the separate DeepSeek worker. Blind file is unchanged and predates reveal; final commands, complete checks, text+ANSI, sizes, selected states, frame timestamps and final pane closure records exist. However, eight earlier probe panes and the owned tab/base pane are only reported closed by generator narrative; no raw close/get confirmation or exact probe cleanup command log is preserved. Cleanup including failures cannot be verified, so this category is blocked rather than awarded a pass.

animation.reason: Animation is required. All eight selected animated routes violate the last human correction (one live dot per line): every route has a multi-dot sample, with four dots on each long v1 line. Twenty timestamped samples exist, but second-scale sampling aliases repeated short routes and cannot prove their direction/speed; configured flow=0.15 is not actual-render proof. No border dots or dot-over-label damage observed. v4 static is allowed because source requests selected communication edges, not every edge.

findings.description: Control-plane create/terminate/repair became create/terminate in both spec and pane. Repair is a distinct required operation, not an abbreviation present elsewhere.
Reinstall/reprovision became reinstall in both spec and pane. Reprovision is not stated anywhere in the final views.

Boot response topology exists, but spec shortens boot.ipxe + S3 args to boot.ipxe, losing the S3-argument payload; renderer then omits even boot.ipxe. A bare return arrow does not convey the required response meaning.
machine state exists in JSON but is entirely absent from the public-gRPC-to-Postgres rendered path; nearby machine rows is a different writer label and cannot substitute.

audit / verify reimage is shortened to audit/reimage. The verification qualifier is lost, allowing a reimage operation rather than verification of reimage; no visible legend preserves the distinction.

The private-gRPC stem at column 26 is overwritten by machine rows on row 30 and meets a bridge glyph on row 31. Stage A could not establish an uninterrupted unique trace to the candidate Postgres arrow at [19,34,1,1]. Expected JSON now identifies intent but cannot retroactively make that link readable. No false connected branch is asserted.

Boxes fit 77x47 at natural zoom, but full required edge labels do not: boot.ipxe and machine state are omitted by placement. Final checks each report one skipped label in v2 and v3. Complete-label gate fails despite spare exterior whitespace and exit status 0.

Layer hues encode geometric depth rather than stable source concepts: v2 puts host agent with boot server and S3 while its host has another hue; v3 puts private gRPC with agent and public gRPC with queue/reconcile. Bare-metal machines changes from orange (v1) to gold (v2/v3) to pink (v4). No displayed legend/group explanation makes these source-backed conceptual categories; generation explicitly claims per-layer color grouping.

Every selected animated route has a sample with more than one simultaneous dot, contradicting the final human correction to keep one dot alive per line. Long v1 runs show four dots each. Slow flow=0.15 is not a dot-count control. Samples prove phase changes, not reliable direction/speed on short aliased routes; no border or label dots were observed.

blockers: Missing executed cleanup evidence for eight earlier probe panes and dedicated tab w7E:tT/base pane w7E:p31. Generation asserts closure, but only the four final pane_not_found responses are recorded. No live pane operations were performed to fill the gap.
Timestamped samples are too sparse to disambiguate phase/direction/speed on the short repeated-dot routes. The known multi-dot violation remains fail regardless of this evidence gap.

Frozen documented spec supports flow speed but exposes no evidenced one-dot-count control; reducing speed alone does not enforce the source request. A supported way to produce one live dot per route has not been demonstrated. No renderer capability change was attempted.

cleanup.reason: Final viewer panes independently confirmed absent in their four raw cleanup records. Eight probe closures and dedicated tab/base-pane closure are generator assertions only; not verified. Reviewer opened no panes.
